configui.title: Project setup
configui.file.title: The profile
configui.file.whereText: In AYAR’s data folder on this computer, not in the repository.
configui.file.inRepo: A copy is in the repository (.ayar/profile.json); importing it shows its difference before approval.
configui.file.notInRepo: Not exported yet. Exporting saves a copy in the project folder through a save dialog; AYAR never writes in the repository by itself.
configui.file.importNote: Importing shows the difference before approval, and no changed command runs before it is approved.
configui.file.changed: {count, plural, one {# check changed} other {# checks changed}}
configui.file.removed: {count, plural, one {# check removed} other {# checks removed}}
configui.file.approved: {count, plural, one {and # command approved} other {and # commands approved}}
configui.file.source.edited: An edit from the project setup
configui.checks.title: Checks ({applicable} applicable · {shown} shown)
configui.checks.note: Every change to the command, «required» or «blocking» is kept as a pending change and needs approval before the next run.
configui.env.title: The computed tools
configui.env.readAt: The terminal environment was read from {shell} on {date}
configui.env.noOverrides: No overrides. An override pins a tool’s version or path for this project, and enters the approval.
configui.env.withheldNote: Variables that look like secrets are not passed by default. Their values are never shown here.
configui.refs.design: Design tokens, fonts and the render target
configui.refs.policyMissing: No reason written in the policy
configui.refs.policyNote: The reasons are written in the policy file in the repository; AYAR reads it and never writes in it.
configui.refs.budgetsNote: Times in milliseconds, sizes in bytes. Every page and state is measured on a slowed processor.
configui.refs.expectations: Each state has a declared expectation, such as «error: a message with a try-again button». The network is simulated so the state shows.
configui.context.title: Context declarations
configui.context.optional: All optional, each with «I don’t know»
configui.context.hint: They shape the suggested checks and cards and the order of «what needs your attention», and change no check’s result.
configui.approval.needs: {count, plural, one {# change needs your approval} other {# changes need your approval}}
configui.approval.none: No pending changes: everything that runs is approved.
configui.approval.blocked: Cannot be approved in this mode
configui.services.title: Companion services ({count})
configui.services.maybeRunning: May be running with the active run
configui.services.note: AYAR starts the service before the checks that need it, waits for its readiness sign, then stops it after them. If it is not ready in time, those checks show «unavailable: the companion service was not ready» with its log.
configui.services.none: No companion services. Add the development server if the render checks need it.
configui.services.name: Service name
configui.services.readyHint: An address on this computer, or a text its log shows
configui.services.approvalNote: The service’s command is a project command: approved with every check that needs it, and never run in the untrusted mode.
configui.trust.title: Mode
configui.trust.trustedNote: The project’s approved commands run: the build, the tests and the rest.
configui.trust.untrustedNote: For a project whose code you do not trust yet, such as a repository you just downloaded: no project command runs, and only the reading tools work.
configui.trust.banner: Untrusted mode: the project’s commands do not run in this mode
